sanskrit:
स तया श्रद्धया युक्तस्तस्याराधनमीहते।
लभते च ततः कामान्मयैव विहितान्हि तान्।।
image_english: Endowed with such faith, he worships that demigod and obtains desires. But these are bestowed by Me alone.
caption:
Chapter 7, Verse 22

Kṛṣṇa explains who actually grants the benediction. ‘sa tayā śraddhayā yuktas’ (Endowed with such a faith, he endeavors to worship a particular demigod and obtains his desires). ‘vihitān hi mayā’ (But in reality these benefits are bestowed by Me alone). The demigod is like a cashier; he can only pay what the Manager (Kṛṣṇa) authorizes. If you get money from Lakshmi, it is actually Kṛṣṇa’s money. The foolish worshiper thanks the cashier and ignores the Manager.
